name: f9_structural_wearing_specificity_exploratory_v1
source: Per subject, source-fitted F9v2 plus availability-aware mask on LibEMG Electrode Shift training-domain eight-channel 200Hz native windows
targets: The same six frozen validation/final subjects and four after-wearing target domains as WEARING_PROTOCOL.json
rule: Reject a native trial only if any of its native windows has any channel zero fraction >=0.50 or longest flatline ratio >=0.50. Add clip fraction >=0.10 only when ADC rail metadata are attested; no rail is attested here. Mains and pre-highpass states are also unavailable. No soft amplitude, correlation, line or low-frequency score can reject.
control: Read F0v2 probabilities unchanged from WEARING_TRIAL_PREDICTIONS.csv by exact native trial ID. Report coverage, correct and erroneous trials rejected, and after-wearing domain counts. Inject one copied constant channel to check an observable structural event separately.
limits: All target domains and users were previously inspected in Feature Bank studies. This is a post-parent exploratory specificity diagnostic under electrode replacement, not new final validation, physical-fault sensitivity, 250Hz transfer or live deployment. Do not target-tune or promote automatically.
